send_email.description: Send a customizable email via Amazon SES with verified sender addresses

emailTags.description: Key-value pairs for email tracking and analytics

aiMetadata.description: Sends a one-off email through Amazon SES from a verified sender, with HTML or plain-text body (HTML mode auto-generates a text fallback), plus optional CC/BCC, reply-to, return path, configuration set, and tags. Use to deliver ad-hoc messages where the content is supplied inline rather than from a stored template. The sender address must already be verified in SES, and the chosen body format requires its matching content field. Not idempotent: each call dispatches a new email.

create_email_template.description: Create a reusable HTML or text email template with variables

htmlPart.description: HTML email content with variables like {{firstName}}

textPart.description: Plain text email content with variables like {{firstName}}

checkExisting.description: Verify template name is unique before creating

sampleData.description: Test data for template variables (optional preview)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a reusable Amazon SES email template (HTML, plain text, or both) with {{variable}} placeholders that can later be sent via Send Templated Email. Use when setting up a named template for repeated sends rather than dispatching a message now. The template name must be unique; by default the action fails if a template with that name already exists. Not idempotent: it registers a new template and errors on a duplicate name.

send_templated_email.name: send_templated_email
send_templated_email.description: Send personalized emails using pre-created templates

templateName.description: Select template to use for this email

emailTags.description: Key-value pairs for email tracking and analytics

aiMetadata.description: Sends an email through Amazon SES rendered from an existing named template, substituting the supplied key-value template variables, with optional CC/BCC, reply-to, return path, configuration set, and tags. Use when the message body lives in a pre-created SES template rather than inline content. Requires a verified sender, a template that already exists, and at least one template variable. Not idempotent: each call dispatches a new email.

update_email_template.name: update_email_template
update_email_template.description: Modify an existing email template with new content

loadCurrentContent.description: Pre-fill fields with existing template content

textPart.description: Plain text email content with variables like {{firstName}}

preserveUnspecified.description: Keep existing HTML/text content if not provided

sampleData.description: Test data for template variables (optional preview)

aiMetadata.description: Overwrites an existing Amazon SES email template, replacing its subject and HTML/text content; an optional preserve-unspecified mode keeps the current HTML or text when a field is left blank instead of clearing it. Use to edit a template that already exists, not to create one. Idempotent: repeating the call with the same input leaves the template in the same final state.

create_custom_verification_email_templat.description: Create custom email template for identity verification

templateName.description: Unique template name (letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens only)

checkExisting.description: Verify template name is unique before creating

validateUrls.description: Check that redirect URLs are properly formatted

aiMetadata.description: Creates a custom Amazon SES verification email template — the message sent to recipients to confirm an email identity — with a verified from-address, subject, HTML content (should contain the verification link), and success/failure redirect URLs. Use when defining the verification email before calling Send Custom Verification Email. The template name must be unique; by default it fails if one already exists. Not idempotent: it registers a new template and errors on a duplicate name.

send_custom_verification_email.name: send_custom_verification_email
send_custom_verification_email.description: Send verification email to add an email address to SES identities

emailAddress.description: Email address to verify and add to identities

validateEmailFormat.description: Check email address format before sending

checkExistingIdentity.description: Warn if email is already a verified identity

aiMetadata.description: Sends a custom verification email via Amazon SES to a target address using an existing custom verification template, starting the flow that adds that address as a verified SES identity once the recipient clicks the link. Use to begin verifying a new sender/recipient identity. Requires a pre-created verification template and (outside SES sandbox) production access to verify arbitrary addresses. Not idempotent: each call sends another verification email.

aiMetadata.description: Overwrites an existing Amazon SES custom verification email template, replacing its from-address, subject, content, and success/failure redirect URLs; an optional preserve-unspecified mode keeps the current values when fields are left blank. Use to edit a verification template that already exists, not to create one. Idempotent: repeating the call with the same input leaves the template in the same final state.
